item.description:
⚡ The history heatmap now shows all of your past usage, updates install on their own, and a first launch no longer looks like the
app never started.

⚠️ Heads up: the first launch after updating reads your Claude, Codex and Copilot logs again, which keeps the CPU busy for about
a minute. Everyone will also see the new welcome card once. Press Got it to close it.

✨ New

  • 👋 A fresh install opens a welcome card under the notch instead of hiding. It lists each provider, what it has reported, and the
    one thing to do if it can't be read.
  • 🔄 Updates install on their own the next time your Mac is quiet, so you no longer need to quit the app. The card then tells you
    which version you're on, with a link to what's new.
  • ↻ A button in the card reads your usage right away instead of waiting for the next check.
  • 🔀 By model, By project and By kind can switch between the 5-hour window and the weekly limit, and they list every row with a
    scroll.

🔧 Fixed

  • 📅 Copilot and older Codex versions now fill in the whole 90-day heatmap.
  • ⏱️ Claude's reset times are read correctly again, so the countdown no longer shows "4h 59m" after every refresh.
  • 📁 By project names the repository, not whichever subfolder the agent happened to be in.
  • 🖱️ Buttons in the notch cards light up under the pointer again.
  • 🧹 Model names are shown exactly as the CLI logs them, and the heatmap no longer prints two month names on top of each other.

💬 Tell me what breaks: https://tokenpacer.com/#feedback
